notes: Only the assigned brief, C, H, C_alerts, PREAMBLE, source_paths, notation_snapshot and scan-004 images were read. No other scan or reader folder was inspected; no delegation, OCR, recognition software, PDF text layer, research, or web access was used. The first recorded UTC timestamp was obtained after the initial brief/packet read.

Image coverage: the whole image was opened exactly once for layout, followed by half_a exactly once and half_b exactly once in that order. These two ordered reads compared every word, accent, ending, punctuation, abbreviation, deletion, insertion, quotation mark, and every inline/display formula against BOTH C and H, including agreed readings. The inventory and notation entries identify the complete physical spans. Nineteen unresolved loci then each received one distinct tight crop, LANCZOS upscaled and autocontrasted; each was viewed once. No half was enlarged again and no locus was recropped.

This sheet is a typescript with pen mathematical entries and corrections. A dark page number 3 is at the upper centre, and a separate thinner archive-pencil 3 is in the lower-left margin. There is no date, salutation, signature, total page count, separate diagram, or independent non-diagram drawing. The curved lines near doit and géométrique and the caret for Deligne are insertion connectors, represented at their attachments rather than as detached figures.

The opening paragraph states that classification up to tensor equivalence is in terms of a group pi_0, a commutative group pi_1 with action, and an arbitrary degree-three cohomology class. It then mentions a geometrical Baer interpretation of the cohomology group law. These are statements made by the page; no theorem or proof was checked in this run.

The examples retain their tentative wording: on doit retrouver the Postnikoff invariant, the autoequivalence invariant semble nouveau, and a direct geometrical link to Mac-Lane’s extension/kernel theory remains to be developed. I checked the ink of these assertions and did not independently validate the mathematical or historical claims.

The heading and strictness definition of Picard categories, the final s in champs de Picards, and the unfinished closing paragraph are fully present in reading.tex. The closing action target retains pi_0/pi_1 uncertainty because of the looped retouched subscript; theoretical expectations did not decide that glyph.

Doit, développer and géométrique are regular typewriter additions. Their pen hooks do not make the words themselves handwritten. Deligne and the three empty reference-bracket pairs are pen additions. Direct is still live and singly underlined; its preceding insertion hook places géométrique before it.

Six C uncertainties were removed after the one tight crop at each locus: opening parenthesis within the split géométrique, cancelled let, cancelled développées ici, the conjunction et, old E under G, and cancelled (Gr) before tensor-structure. Eight C uncertainties are retained as explicit doubts, all listed in changes and unresolved. The report distinguishes these uncertainty-state decisions from ordinary macro-name conversion.

Every C alert was considered, including those where both witnesses agree: raised degree 3 versus the separate H, the two example-2 degrees 1 and 0, plain heading initials C and P, plain ACU/AU and A/F, tensor signs, both underlined O expressions, and the raised category prime. Postnikoff has both final f letters; Anneau retains capital A; groupoide has a single i dot; the cancelled élement has only its first acute accent; champs de Picards has its final s; splittages has double t. These agreed items are documented in notation/coverage rather than inflated into extra no-change rows.

Differences already settled in the halves are labelled settled_in_half for the main reader’s adjudication crops. They include the omitted formula comma, certain quotation typography, the readable cancelled catég, the section-heading underline, and the archive number. H’s editorial note does suggest cancelled établir with uncertainty, so it is not reported as an entirely absent word; its main text still leaves the cancellation as ill.

All cancelled layers and live replacements are separately preserved. The x masks are represented with the supplied rlap/deleted convention; no mathematical normalization, grammar repair, silent accent restoration or completion of the unfinished last sentence has been made. No mathematical checks were performed, and math_checks is deliberately empty.
